thread:
Maya: Heads up — starting ~09:37 UTC we saw a spike of 500s from model-serve v2 in us-west. Long-context jobs failing ~30%. Thinking a short-lived, header-based surgical reroute to v1-edge to buy time. Can we do a toggle behind the gateway?

Jon: Yep. Header injection at the gateway is the least invasive. Add an opt-in header like `x-rdr-variant: safe` and rewrite route to v1-edge. No model rollout churn.

Priya: @Maya if we flip this, what's the rollback and alerting plan? Need an admin toggle + automatic revert if it gets worse.

Maya: Plan: 1) push gateway rule disabled behind admin toggle, 2) do 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% with 2m observation windows, 3) thresholds: error-rate > 2x baseline or p95 latency +1000ms = immediate revert, 4) ops-bot auto-revert TTL 10m as a safety net. I'll write runbook.

Elena: Config snippet for the gateway (staging):
```
routes:
  - match: path_prefix("/v2/generate")
    when: header("x-rdr-fix") == "1"
    rewrite:
      set_header: { "x-route-target": "v1-edge" }
```
Keep it behind toggle so we don't commit direct weight changes.

Jon: Admin API to flip toggle (example):
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/routing/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"toggle":"v2-divert","state":"on","canary":0.05}'
```
We can update `canary` progressively.

Sam: :thumbsup: Make sure we attach an audit tag and TTL to the toggle so it auto-expires if forgotten. Also add a note in Console rollouts UX so PMs see temporary change.

ops-bot: ops-bot: auto-revert available. Use `--auto-revert-seconds=600` and pass `runbook_id` to attach. Will post a confirmation when toggle is applied.

Priya: I'll own monitoring during the flip. Dashboards to watch: errors by route, p95 latency by model variant, request volume, token cost. If errors spike I revert via the admin API.

Maya: Deploying rule to staging now, will push prod disabled behind toggle in ~10m. ETA to first canary flip ~25m.

Jon: When ready, test curl to hit reroute: `curl -H "x-rdr-fix: 1" https://api.us-west.redwood.internal/v2/generate`. That should route to v1-edge if toggle on.

Elena: Left a tiny test harness at `/infra/playbooks/reroute-checker` (script that hits path and validates model fingerprint).

Priya: Added alert run: `alert: v2_errors_increase` -> notify #oncall + page if sustained for 2min.

Maya: Toggle is live in staging. Will post prod toggle URL and ops-bot confirmation when pushed.

Sam: Thanks — keep PMs updated in the rollout doc.

Maya: Prod toggle pushed (disabled). URL: `https://admin.internal/routing/toggle/v2-divert`

ops-bot: ops-bot: toggle created (id: toggle-9831), auto-revert 600s disabled by default. Use `POST /routing/toggle/toggle-9831/actions` to flip.

Maya: Flipped canary->5%. Monitoring now.

Priya: Observing — error rate down ~40% on canary traffic, no latency regression so far. Holding at 5% for two windows.

Maya: If anything regresses revert with: `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/routing/toggle -d '{"toggle":"v2-divert","state":"off"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"`

Jon: After we reach 100% we'll schedule a follow-up to bake the fix into v2 or do a proper rollout of the corrected binary.

Priya: Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/reroute-emergency-2026-03 (added monitoring playbook).

Maya: Closing loop once we either rollback permanently or the v2 fix is out. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
